  <section v="24">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the blessing "Blessed is He who performed miracles... in this time" is actually a request for miracles in the present, and just as the blessing for forgiveness removes doubt, so too this blessing assures that miracles will occur now.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>

    <t s="2">And it is explained in the maamar</t>
    <t s="3">(at its conclusion and seal)</t>
    <t s="4">that what is said "Blessed is He who performed miracles... in this time" is a request that there should be miracles also in this time.</t>
    <t s="5">And according to what the Alter Rebbe said</t>
    <t s="6">(the master of the joy and redemption of 19 Kislev)</t>
    <t s="7">in Tanya45</t>
    <t s="8">regarding the request "Forgive us,"</t>
    <t s="9">that since we bless</t>
    <t s="10">(after the request)</t>
    <t s="11">"Blessed are You, Hashem, the gracious One who abundantly forgives,"</t>
    <t s="12">there is no doubt about this — it is understood,</t>
    <t s="13">that likewise it is regarding the request that the Holy One, blessed be He, perform miracles also in this time,</t>
    <t s="14">that since we bless "Blessed... who performed miracles... in this time,"</t>
    <t s="15">there is no doubt,</t>

    <t s="21">that will be at the coming of Mashiach our righteous one — that also these miracles will be in this time,</t>
    <t s="22">in the truly imminent future,</t>
    <t s="23">at the coming of Mashiach our righteous one, speedily in our days, literally.</t>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the blessing "Blessed is He who performed miracles... in this time" is actually a request for miracles in the present, and just as the blessing for forgiveness removes doubt, so too this blessing assures that miracles will occur now.

translations.translation: And 4)
And it is explained in the maamar
(at its conclusion and seal)
that what is said "Blessed is He who performed miracles... in this time" is a request that there should be miracles also in this time.
And according to what the Alter Rebbe said
(the master of the joy and redemption of 19 Kislev)
in Tanya45
regarding the request "Forgive us,"
that since we bless
(after the request)
"Blessed are You, Hashem, the gracious One who abundantly forgives,"
there is no doubt about this — it is understood,
that likewise it is regarding the request that the Holy One, blessed be He, perform miracles also in this time,
that since we bless "Blessed... who performed miracles... in this time,"
there is no doubt,
that in this time,
in the imminent future,
the Holy One, blessed be He, will perform miracles (in the plural),
all four types mentioned above,
including also the miracles of "We will show him wonders"46
that will be at the coming of Mashiach our righteous one — that also these miracles will be in this time,
in the truly imminent future,
at the coming of Mashiach our righteous one, speedily in our days, literally.
